UIbasic — Basic Persistent User Interface Protocol — v1.0 CHANGELOG

v1.0 - Recreated the previous persistent UI update package as
independent UIbasic. - Preserved TINY, COMPACT, FULL and AUTO modes. -
Preserved truthful state/progress requirements. - Preserved persistent
mode selection. - Preserved functional controls and next-step engine. -
Preserved failure/recovery/blocker behavior. - Preserved
responsive/mobile-first requirements. - Preserved QA gate and AFTER
UPDATE packaging behavior. - Removed AOS-specific project identity from
the package itself; AOS remains usable as an orchestrator when
available.
